decision: Empirical simulation price bounds and action grid

implementation_impact: Freeze alpha_min=6.60/P_base, alpha_max=94.70/P_base and K=11; hard-bound numerical tolerance remains part of implementation contract approval.

decision: Destination representation and exact system-state contract
recommended_choice: Approve existing shared q(S,d,k), 142 destination-only factors generated pre-slot, plus existing 142×15 system-grid features and proposed weather/time context with semantic encoding.

implementation_impact: Conditional state width 2135 and shared-query width 2277; these are arithmetic updates to the old 2146/2288 proposal, not approved dimensions. Network layers remain PENDING_APPROVAL.

decision: Slot objective, additive credit, transition boundaries and horizon
recommended_choice: Approve unmatched=0 and R_slot=sum(successfully assigned P_offer); existing additive Q_total=sum_d q(S,d,a_d) with ONE joint slot loss; gamma=0.99 per 30-minute slot.
alternative: Require a different explicitly approved aggregation/credit or horizon contract; no destination-specific reward mechanism is invented.
evidence: Professor fixes rejection zero and assigned revenue but does not fix aggregation. Existing design uses total reward once, not copied into 142 separate transitions. Gamma half-life about 34.48 hours.
why_approval_needed: Shared fleet couples destinations; unmatched wording is not an explicit exhaustive rule. Empty slots, true terminal versus truncation and bootstrap convention require explicit agreement.
implementation_impact: Approve one schedule transition and additive joint target; terminal/truncation and episode boundaries remain PENDING_APPROVAL until named. No request-step discount reuse.

recommended_choice: Approve existing global completed-drop-off EWMA proposal with lambda=0.30, lagged causal update and empty-slot carry-forward; historical initialization.

implementation_impact: Final producer definition and initialization window remain PENDING_APPROVAL. Jan1–7 initialization was validation evidence, not automatic authorization for training dates before Jan8.
